conditions.name: Execution Capacity
conditions.summary: Execution Capacity is limiting organizational performance. Execution demand appears to exceed the organization's available capacity, focus, coordination bandwidth, or decision throughput. The strongest drivers are Strategic Alignment Drift Is Weakening Execution. If ignored, strategic work remains incomplete because organizational demand outpaces the system's ability to absorb and execute it. This should be monitored and improved where it constrains execution. If improved, execution should become more reliable as work is prioritized, sequenced, and protected from avoidable coordination drag. This is a new condition-level signal. Discovery has not yet observed enough history to distinguish whether Execution Capacity is persistent, temporary, or recently changed. Execution Capacity appears connected to Knowledge Continuity and Strategic Alignment upstream and may influence Learning System downstream.
conditions.whyItMatters: Execution capacity determines whether strategic intent can become completed work. Execution Capacity is constrained because the evidence suggests execution demand appears to exceed the organization's available capacity, focus, coordination bandwidth, or decision throughput. Discovery sees 1 concept behind this assessment, with 79% confidence and 54% condition strength.
conditions.recommendedExecutiveAction: Identify where demand exceeds execution capacity and protect the highest-leverage work. conditions.name: Knowledge Continuity
conditions.summary: Knowledge Continuity is limiting organizational performance. Knowledge remains localized in people, conversations, or one-off work rather than becoming reusable organizational memory. The strongest drivers are Organizational Learning Failure and Strategic Alignment Drift Is Weakening Execution. If ignored, teams rediscover context, repeat prior work, and become more dependent on individuals who hold institutional knowledge. This is a lower-priority signal until more evidence accumulates. If improved, the organization should onboard faster, repeat fewer mistakes, and preserve understanding through growth or personnel change. This is a new condition-level signal. Discovery has not yet observed enough history to distinguish whether Knowledge Continuity is persistent, temporary, or recently changed. Knowledge Continuity appears connected to Learning System upstream and may influence Execution Capacity downstream.

conditions.name: Execution Capacity
conditions.summary: Execution Capacity is limiting organizational performance. The strongest drivers are Strategic Alignment Drift Is Weakening Execution.
